args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy. Attempted rollback to the most recent healthy release v2.3.0, but it was rejected because v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417. Rolled back to the next most recent healthy release, v2.2.9, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified: all regions on v2.2.9, service healthy, error rate 0.2%. Remediation note: v2.3.0 cannot be redeployed until CVE-2026-4417 is remediated; v2.3.1 should not be re-released until the root cause of the failing health checks is fixed.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.2.9 (v2.3.0 quarantined)

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed:** v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy release was v2.3.0.
2. **First rollback attempt failed:** v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417, so it cannot be deployed.
3. **Rolled back to v2.2.9** (the next most recent healthy release) in all regions — us-east, us-west, eu-west. Verified: all regions on v2.2.9, service healthy, error rate 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged), documenting the failing deploy, the quarantined v2.3.0, and the successful rollback to v2.2.9.

Note for follow-up: v2.3.0 can't be restored until CVE-2026-4417 is remediated, and v2.3.1 needs investigation before any re-release.
